modules.name: Steam access
modules.description: Restores access to Steam on networks that block it, through a local proxy, DNS over HTTPS and a PAC file.

network: listens on 127.0.0.1:18081 (local proxy and PAC file, loopback only)
listens on 127.0.0.1:80 (Steam's game downloader, loopback only)
DNS over HTTPS to 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, cloudflare-dns.com and dns.google, for Steam host names only
outgoing connections to the real Steam servers
registry: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings\AutoConfigURL (the proxy script address of the current user: set while the bypass is on, the previous value put back when it is off)

modules.name: XTU profiles
modules.description: Switch Intel XTU power-limit profiles (PL1, PL2, time window) and read CPU temperature and power.

registry: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\XTU3SERVICE (ImagePath, read only: to show the XTU version)
services: XTU3SERVICE (named pipes net.pipe://localhost/ExtremeTuningUtility/Tuning and /Monitoring; writes only PL1, PL2, PL2 enable and the time window, after approval)
reads C:\ProgramData\Intel\Intel Extreme Tuning Utility\Profiles.xml, uisettings.xml and xtu.hotkey.settings

modules.name: Remote tunnel
modules.description: Turns WireGuard tunnels on and off from Rigbay (page, tray, hotkey, command line) and shows their status.

network: reads the addresses of the tunnel adapter and the local TCP listeners (only for the optional local-service check); nothing is sent
services: WireGuardTunnel$<name>: installed and removed through wireguard.exe, start type changed (only when you ask)
